chart.description: Compares model load latency for each stage
chart.name: Avg load latency by stage
chart.programText:
A = data(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage_sum', filter=filter('stage', 'init_graph'), rollup='latest').sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
B = data(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage_sum', filter=filter('stage', 'restore_graph'), rollup='latest').sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
C = data(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage_count', filter=filter('stage', 'init_graph'), rollup='latest').sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
D = data(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage_count', filter=filter('stage', 'restore_graph'), rollup='latest').sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
E = ((0 if A is None else A)/(1 if C is None else 1 if C is 0 else C)).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
F = ((0 if B is None else B)/(1 if D is None else 1 if D is 0 else D)).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
G = histogram(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage', filter=filter('stage', 'init_graph')).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
H = histogram(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage', filter=filter('stage', 'restore_graph')).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
I = histogram(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage', filter=filter('stage', 'init_graph')).count(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
J = histogram(':tensorflow:cc:saved_model:load_latency_by_stage', filter=filter('stage', 'restore_graph')).count(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
K = ((0 if G is None else G)/(1 if I is None else 1 if I is 0 else I)).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
L = ((0 if H is None else H)/(1 if J is None else 1 if J is 0 else J)).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address'])
M = union(E,K).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).publish(label='M', enable=True)
N = union(F,L).sum(by=['model_path', 'server.address']).publish(label='N', enable=True)

F = (D/E).sum(by=['model_name'])
G = combine(C if F is None else F).publish(label='G')
